title: Assembler - 2nd Shift
description:
PGS Worldwide is actively seeking a Conformal Coating Technician to support electronic assembly production operations in Oldsmar, FL. This 1-year contract-to-hire position focuses on coating, masking, and potting processes to ensure high-quality circuit board finishes that meet aerospace and defense standards.

The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, have experience working with dispensing and coating machines, and be capable of maintaining production quality in a clean, safety-conscious environment.

Required Qualifications:

  • Ability to operate dispensing and conformal coating machines to meet specifications

  • Detail-oriented with excellent manual dexterity

  • Ability to read and follow engineering drawings, written instructions, and process procedures

  • Basic understanding of materials, coatings, and potting compounds

  • Strong attention to quality and safety standards

  • Must be able to read and write English

  • Must pass a medical exam as outlined in the supplier guide

  • U.S. Citizenship required due to program requirements

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in electronics manufacturing or circuit board coating

  • Familiarity with masking, taping, or manual touch-up of coated assemblies

  • Experience maintaining and cleaning coating and dispensing machinery

  • Background working in aerospace, defense, or high-reliability electronics environments

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate a variety of dispensing and coating machines to meet customer specifications

  • Mask and tape circuit boards in areas requiring protection from coatings or potting materials

  • Inspect assemblies to ensure complete and consistent coating coverage

  • Perform manual touch-ups and remove excess coating as necessary

  • Maintain and service machines by changing fluids, mixers, and cleaning equipment

  • Replenish chemicals, solvents, and process fluids safely and efficiently

  • Prepare and apply potting, bonding, and coating compounds

  • Perform general housekeeping and maintenance to sustain a clean, safe workspace

  • Retrieve materials, tools, and product from in-house and local suppliers as needed

title: Aircraft Component Technician
description:
PGS Worldwide is actively seeking a skilled Aircraft Component Technician to support aircraft component repair and overhaul operations in Trumbull, CT. This 1-year contract-to-hire position is classified as a safety-sensitive role and will require participation in an FAA-approved Drug and Alcohol testing program.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with precision measuring instruments, component disassembly and assembly, and the ability to perform detailed mechanical repairs and modifications in accordance with FAA, CAA, and EASA standards.

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent (required)

  • 3+ years of hands-on mechanical or component repair experience

  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision

  • Proficient in the use of precision measuring tools (feeler gauges, dial indicators, micrometers, calipers)

  • Skilled in mechanical repair techniques, including filing, stoning, lapping, and polishing

  • Experience with power and hand tools for drilling, sanding, riveting, and general component repair

  • Ability to clearly document evaluation results and communicate repair requirements

  • Knowledge of FAA, CAA, and EASA maintenance standards and compliance procedures

  • Familiarity with torque wrenches and SAC torque specification SS9300

  • Ability to chemically treat repaired surfaces per approved data

  • U.S. Citizenship required due to program requirements

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Completion of an Automotive or Technical Trade School program

  • FAA Airframe License (preferred, not required)

  • Previous experience performing aircraft component maintenance or overhaul

  • Proficiency interpreting component maintenance manuals, service bulletins, and engineering drawings

Key Responsibilities:

  • Disassemble, clean, evaluate, and perform repairs, modifications, and reassembly of aircraft components

  • Use measuring instruments to verify tolerances and ensure quality standards

  • Drill, ream, tap, change studs, install heli-coils, bushings, and liners using proper mechanical techniques

  • Accurately document work performed, repair findings, and parts disposition

  • Follow all safety, environmental, and FAA regulatory requirements

  • Collaborate with quality and engineering personnel to resolve technical issues

  • Adhere to company policies, procedures, and corporate EH&S initiatives

title: Maintainability / RAM / Logistics Engineer
description:
BAE Systems is seeking an experienced Principal Maintainability, Reliability, Availability, Maintainability (RAM), or Logistics Engineer to join our team in Sterling Heights, MI. The ideal candidate will provide engineering expertise to enhance system supportability, reduce life cycle costs, and improve maintainability for complex defense systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform Maintenance Task Analysis (MTA), defining maintenance task steps, equipment, tools, personnel, and time requirements

  • Conduct Level of Repair Analysis (LORA) and Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM)

  • Calculate and interpret Maintenance Ratio, Mean Time To Repair (MTTR), and Max Time To Repair (MaxTTR)

  • Assess and document the impact of engineering changes on system maintainability, logistics, spares, tools, and personnel

  • Recommend design improvements based on analysis to enhance system supportability and reduce life cycle cost

  • Develop, revise, and maintain technical documentation, and contribute to technical papers and presentations

Skills Required:

  • Extensive experience with Slicwave

  • Ability to independently perform:

    • Level of Repair Analysis (LORA)

    • Maintenance Task Analysis (MTA)

    • Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM)

Skills Preferred:

  • Experience with ReliaSoft and Opus software tools

Experience Required:

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Maintainability, RAM, or Logistics Engineering

Education Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree in a relevant technical discipline, or equivalent military service experience

title: Electronics Test Technician
description:
PGS Worldwide is actively seeking an experienced Electronics Test Technician to join our team in Oldsmar, FL for a 1-year contract-to-hire opportunity. In this role, you will perform setup, testing, troubleshooting, and calibration of electronic circuit card assemblies, RF circuits, and subassembly units in support of high-performance defense systems.

Required Skills:

  • Minimum 1 year of direct experience testing electronic assemblies

  • Proficient in component-level troubleshooting of solid-state, digital, and RF circuits

  • Experience using schematic diagrams to isolate failures in analog and digital circuitry

  • Strong knowledge of solid-state devices and micro-circuitry

  • Skilled with test and measurement equipment including:

    • Digital multimeters

    • Oscilloscopes

    • Network analyzers

    • Signal generators

    • RF power meters

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and data collection/reporting software

  • Experience with flying probe and high-power test systems

Preferred Skills:

  • Extensive RF testing experience

  • Familiarity with Radar systems or military avionics testing

  • Experience in defense manufacturing or depot-level repair environments

  • Military “backshop” experience in electronics troubleshooting and repair strongly preferred

Responsibilities:

  • Set up test apparatus and conduct functional and performance tests of electronic assemblies and subassemblies

  • Adjust, calibrate, and repair electronic systems as required

  • Troubleshoot to the component level to identify and correct malfunctions

  • Review test results, recommend process or product improvements, and assist engineers in developing new test procedures

  • Ensure quality and accuracy of testing in accordance with established procedures and standards

  • Maintain accurate documentation of test data and maintenance actions

Education & Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required

  • Additional specialized technical training or an associate degree in electronics preferred

Additional Details:

  • Candidates demonstrating advanced skill and extensive RF/military electronics experience will be considered for higher pay rates

title: Senior Subcontract Administrator
description:
PGS Worldwide is actively seeking an experienced Senior Subcontract Administrator to join our team in Lexington, KY for a 1-year contract-to-hire opportunity. This position supports the Special Operations Forces – Global Logistics Sustainment Services (SOF GLSS) program, providing critical logistics and sustainment support to multiple defense platforms. This role requires the ability to obtain a Secret Security Clearance.

Required Skills:

  • Extensive experience in Government procurements and subcontract acquisitions

  • Comprehensive understanding of FAR and DFAR regulations

  • Strong background in cost/price analysis, proposal evaluation, and negotiations

  • Experience managing subcontracts from RFP through lifecycle completion

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

  • Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills

  • Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

  • Experience with Statements of Work (SOWs) and contract administration best practices

Preferred Skills:

  • Working knowledge of U.S. Department of Defense contract types

  • Experience with SAP systems

  • Ability to establish new suppliers and manage supplier performance

  • Familiarity with labor contracts and competitive/non-competitive price agreements

  • Understanding of Special Operations Forces (SOF) environments

  • Experience leading Subcontract Management Teams (SMTs) and complex negotiations

  • Strong ability to communicate with executive leadership, suppliers, and cross-functional teams

Responsibilities:

  • Manage subcontracts of varying complexity throughout their entire lifecycle—from proposal to execution

  • Oversee cost, schedule, and performance compliance for assigned subcontracts

  • Implement supplier corrective actions and lead return-to-green efforts as needed

  • Provide regular status reports to senior and executive leadership

  • Collaborate with compliance teams to support internal and external audits

  • (Senior levels only) Mentor and serve as a subject-matter resource for complex subcontract efforts involving specification- and SOW-driven requirements

Additional Details:

  • Must be eligible to obtain a Secret Clearance

  • Experience with SOF GLSS programs highly desirable

  • Experience designing and implementing logical and mathematical software solutions

  • Ability to analyze system capabilities, define output requirements, and resolve programming and control issues

Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with embedded systems or mission-critical software environments

  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills

  • Strong documentation and communication abilities
